description: This file defines the ReporterV2 interface and a wrapper class for handling test reporting in Playwright, including methods for reporting test events, errors, and output streams.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps a Reporter to implement the ReporterV2 interface, managing deferred output and event forwarding.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Function to wrap a Reporter or ReporterV2 as a ReporterV2 instance.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2' indicating the reporter version.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the reporter.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Called when a test begins; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output chunks; defers if necessary.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error chunks; defers if necessary.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Called when a test ends; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of all tests; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test step; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step; forwards to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio; defaults to true if not specified.
